info.title: Secure Session Demo API
info.description:
Minimal demo API providing session auth endpoints for a Swift iOS client.

Auth flow:
1) POST /auth/login -> returns access_token + refresh_token
2) Use `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` for protected routes (e.g., GET /me)
3) When access_token expires, POST /auth/refresh with refresh_token -> new access_token (+ rotated refresh_token)
4) POST /auth/logout with refresh_token -> revoke refresh token

Notes:
- Refresh tokens are stored in-memory (lost on process restart).
- Access tokens are stateless and expire based on `exp`.

get.description: Health check endpoint used by deployment/runtime monitors.

post.description: Demo login endpoint. Accepts any username/password and returns tokens with expiry.

post.summary: Refresh access token (and rotate refresh token)
post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token. For demo safety, refresh tokens are rotated: the old refresh token is revoked and a new one is issued.
Revokes the provided refresh token from the in-memory store. Access tokens remain valid until expiry.

username.title: Username
username.description: Demo username. For demo purposes any username is accepted.

password.title: Password
password.description: Demo password. For demo purposes any password is accepted.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session id (sid claim from access token).

access_expires_at.title: Access Expires At
access_expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the current access token expires.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: The refresh token previously returned by /auth/login or /auth/refresh.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Signed access token to use in Authorization: Bearer <token>.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Opaque refresh token used with /auth/refresh and /auth/logout.
